Understanding the pre-training strategies of encoder-only transformer (BERT) – Masked Language Modeling. Discussion on the in-context learning ability of LLMs.

description: # **CS772: Deep Learning for Natural Language Processing**. Access course lecture recordings on. **CS772: Deep Learning for Natural Language Processing (Autumn, 2025)**. The course CS626 (Speech, NLP, and the Web) being taught in the the CSE Department at IIT Bombay for the last several years creates a strong foundation in NLP, covering the whole NLP stack, starting from morphology to part of speech tagging, to parsing and discourse and pragmatics. Students of this course acquire a strong grip on tasks, techniques, and linguistics of a plethora of NLP problems. CS772 (Deep Learning for Natural Language Processing) comes as a natural sequel to CS626. **Throughout the course, references and allusions will be made to LLMs and GenAI.**. | Week 1 (Week of 28th July) | * Introduction & Course Logistics * *The Evolution of NLP: From Specialists to Giants* by    **Prof.
